en-US.description: Simple little gadget for monitoring CPU performance from your desktop. It displays a real-time graph of CPU performance as well as current usage indicator. Features include user defined colors, transparency.
en-US.longDescription:
CPU Monitor Gadget is a simple little gadget for monitoring CPU performance from your desktop. It displays current CPU usage with a real-time graph. Features include user defined colors and transparency. It comes integrated with a sophisticated processor detection toolkit which provides CPU information.

You can see the utilization of each CPU core. The software is a compact CPU meter tool with tiny footprint. A lot of user customizations are provided to change the look and feel of the application. You can monitor your CPU performance from your desktop without obstructions. The software is for any user, who wants to monitor AMD or Intel CPU performance easily.

Monitoring your CPU usage when playing computer games is something we all want to do from time to time. Whether you're trying to find a bottleneck, or you're just curious, knowing how hard your computer is working is never a bad thing. You can use this software as On-Screen Display (OSD) to monitor your CPU usage when gaming.
en-US.name: Vovsoft CPU Monitor Gadget
